rows.en: Mop Up Remnants
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Defeat enemy forces
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Friendly warship sunk
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Clear without hitting the Garuda
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Our allies are pushed back by the enemy's overwhelming numbers and are struggling.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: The enemy, too, seems to be growing desperate as its strength steadily dwindles.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: But those still refusing to surrender will likely keep resisting to the death.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: We<mk(75,25,6,3)><ar(0,6,3,200)><mk(75,0,6,0,50)><ar(0,6,0,200)><mk(75,-25,6,3,100)><ar(0,6,3,200)> will now head there and, together with our allies, wipe out the enemy forces.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: It will be a hard fight, but I wish you luck.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: With this operation, we've wiped out Grados and the other forces invading Earth.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: The war is surely heading toward its end. The era we are striving for is almost here.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: I have one piece of good news for you all.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: As for the space refugees who lost their place to live in the UCE attack incident,
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Miss Relena held talks with their representative, Kahns, on the refugees' treatment.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: As a result, they reached an agreement for Earth to take in the refugees.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: If this is realized, it's cause for joy. A new history of the Earth Sphere will begin.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: But for that, we must restore peace on the ground so that Miss Relena is free to act.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: As the ones working behind the scenes... we shall fight on to the very end.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: We can't stand still if we want peace. Don't let your guard down, even for an instant.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?
